summary: TaskBoard is a team collaboration and task management web application providing user authentication, task organization, item deletion, and account preference settings.

features.name: User Registration
features.description: Sign up new user accounts with email validation and password requirements.

features.name: Authentication
features.description: User login session management and credential authentication.

features.name: Dashboard & Task Management
features.description: View, create, and remove task items with real-time updates.

features.name: User Preferences & Settings
features.description: Update user display name, profile details, and account configuration.

features.name: Session Termination
features.description: Securely log out and clear authenticated browser session state.
